scientific_integrity: Proof uses stated classical theorems and verified arithmetic reasoning; no independent external validation or publication is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The all-index parity criterion and fixed-order full logarithmic asymptotic expansion are unconditional and use classical sum-of-two-squares and prime-number theorems. The analog for 8-regular partitions is pre-existing; no claim is made for that result. The original 2013 Cui–Gu paper was only accessible through its abstract and later citations; previously unpublished or unindexed overlapping results remain possible. Numerical checks are finite, not proof of the infinite statement.
title: Exact parity support and a full logarithmic counting expansion for 16-regular partitions
